title: ART - Train AI Agents with Reinforcement Learning for Free
description:
ART (Agent Reinforcement Trainer) is an open-source framework that uses GRPO to train multi-step agents on real tasks. It integrates with any Python app and offers serverless RL with 40% lower costs. Perfect for developers building reliable AI agents.
